# Callouts

> [!note]
> A plain note callout.

> [!tip] A custom title
> With **formatting** and a [[Target|link]].

> [!warning]- Folded by default
> Click the title to expand.

> [!question]+ Expanded, foldable
> Click the title to collapse.

> [!info] Nested
> Outer text.
> > [!example]
> > Inner callout.

> [!unknown-type]
> An unknown type falls back to the note style.
